taskTypes.label: Blog Title Generation
taskTypes.description: Generate publishable blog titles, headlines, or naming-style variants from a topic or keyword.
examples: 키워드를 줄테니 블로그 타이틀 여러개 만들기
blog title ideas from a keyword
headline suggestions for a productivity article

taskTypes.label: Structured JSON Generation
taskTypes.description: Generate machine-readable structured output such as JSON objects or item arrays.
examples: 상품 소개 문구를 JSON 형태로 여러개 만들어줘
return a structured list of items as json

taskTypes.label: General Text Generation
taskTypes.description: Generate plain text responses when no specialized structured or title-oriented task type is a better fit.
examples: summarize this topic in plain text
